results.title: Develop a Realistic Timeline, Milestones, and Budget for Your Team
results.content: * How to Develop a Realistic Timeline, Milestones, and Budget for Your Team. * How to Develop a Realistic Timeline, Milestones, and Budget for Your Team. ## How to Develop a Realistic Timeline, Milestones, and Budget for Your Team. Developing realistic project timelines, meaningful milestones, and accurate budgets is essential for team success. Many businesses struggle with resource allocation, talent management, and project delivery, but a well-structured planning process can save time, money, and energy. Before setting project timelines, it’s important to understand your team’s actual capacity. Milestones serve as checkpoints that help teams stay on track and maintain motivation, and they have been proven to help complete projects faster. A detailed, well-researched budget ensures that your team can execute its plans without financial uncertainty. A well-structured project plan connects deliverables with budget allocations and aligns milestones with financial and time constraints. Developing realistic timelines, meaningful milestones, and accurate budgets create the conditions for your team to succeed.

results.title: There are only two accelerators European VCs care about | Sifted
results.content: Despite that, having graduated from YC is still often a shortcut to a meeting with many VCs. But that isn’t the case for other accelerators, says one investor: “Whether [a startup] graduated from a programme doesn't influence whether we take the meeting or invest at all.”. A safe, where early-stage startups receive investment that converts to shares after an agreed valuation on a certain date, would usually have a valuation cap so investors get more for their cash if a company is valued higher than the agreed figure. While the application process is free for founders — and those at too early a stage are offered a place on a free pre-accelerator course — companies that are selected for the programme are expected to cover the cost, which comes to between €25-30k, out of the investment they’re given. Every founder accepted to the accelerator gets the same funding deal: $120k made up of $20k cash and $100k in convertible notes, with Techstars taking 6% of equity — which it receives immediately before the company’s next equity financing of $250k or more.
